settings.title: New to the market · Hill Park

settings.editor:
Built in 2016 near the top of Orchard Rise, the house is arranged over three floors: a garage and utility room at street level, the kitchen and living room above, and four bedrooms on the top floor, where the main bedroom has the tall corner window.

The living room has a herringbone oak floor and faces the garden. The kitchen was refitted in 2022, with an island that seats two.

Hill Park is ten minutes on foot from the Old Town and the station. The primary school at the foot of the hill is rated outstanding, and the path at the end of the garden leads into forty acres of common.
